title: hedyotis kingii
intro: Hedyotis kingii, commonly known as Chinese harebell or Ru Xiang, is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis kingii include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for pain management and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis kingii include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
